scene: At 08:44, Maddoc reaches Mossgate Common with Tessa and Bram after an ordinary 19-minute walk from Tansyhook Crossing. He is seeking a library/reading room, a training ground or a beast-handling place. All three are visible around the village green: a slate-roofed reading house, a fenced practice yard with sand and posts, and a working beast-handling pen with troughs. No access, tuition, person consent or beast contact is established.
focus: Explore the reading house, practice yard and beast pens at Mossgate Common
summary: Maddoc said 'Just follow me' and led willing companions Tessa and Bram to Mossgate Common. He is looking for books, training, or beast handling. Arrival recorded at 08:44, without rolling or granting access.
